en.sayed-ali-raza: at a time when there had been no prophets for some time. People had been in slumber for a long time and the twist of the rope had loosened. The Prophet came with (a Book containing) testification to what (books) were already there and also with a light to be followed.
It is the Qur’ān. If you ask it to speak it won’t do so; but I will tell you about it.
Know that it contains knowledge of what is to come about, stories of the past, cure for your ills and regulation for whatever faces you.
